elements.element: Renewal must either occur only by mutual written agreement or occur automatically.
elements.evidence: The clause selects the permitted automatic-renewal structure: “This Agreement will automatically renew.”

elements.element: If renewal is automatic, each renewal term must be 12 months.
elements.evidence: The clause provides for automatic renewal for “additional 1-year terms,” equivalent to 12 months.

elements.element: If renewal is automatic, Customer must be able to opt out on 30 days' notice.
elements.evidence: Automatic renewal is used, but Customer must give 60 days' notice rather than the preferred 30 days' notice.

elements.element: If renewal is automatic, Vendor must provide Customer a reminder 60 days before renewal.
elements.evidence: No Vendor reminder obligation appears in the operative language. The margin comment is non-operative and does not supply one.

elements.element: Any renewal price increase must be capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no restriction on renewal price increases.
The clause states that the Agreement “will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms.”

elements.element: Customer's required non-renewal notice period must be no more than 60 days.
elements.evidence: Customer may stop renewal by giving 60 days' notice of non-renewal, which meets the maximum permitted period.

elements.element: Any renewal price increase must not exceed 5%.
elements.evidence: The operative language contains no 5% or other cap on renewal price increases.

result.reason: The redline establishes automatic one-year renewals and gives Customer a 60-day non-renewal right, satisfying the fallback notice-window requirement. It does not include any renewal price cap, so the fallback is incomplete. It also fails the preferred 30-day notice period, Vendor reminder, and CPI/3% price cap. The unchanged 90-day post-Initial-Term termination right does not supply the missing renewal requirements. The edit otherwise leaves unrelated termination and fee provisions operative without a direct contradiction, but it is not minimal under the stated standard because it does not reach any complete acceptable level.
